top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a mature, independently confirmed arc from proglucagon processing and the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide through human incretin physiology to demonstrated benefit in type 2 diabetes and obesity. The physiology-led citation to Drucker, Holst and Mojsov is defensible within the three-laureate cap, though it leaves out Knudsen's drug-engineering step and Mojsov's priority relative to Habener remains unsettled by the record. These credit questions are real but do not outweigh the scale and maturity of the achievement, so I rank it above no award.
